245: void l2_cache::tvd_print(FILE *fp, unsigned slice) {
246:   m_tvd->advance(m_gpu_cycle_for_tvd()); const auto &s = m_tvd->stats();
247:   fprintf(fp,"EPL2TVDV3|METADATA_COST|slice=%u|frontend_cam_queries=%llu|frontend_cam_ports=1|completion_cam_queries=%llu|completion_cam_ports=1|indexed_wb_accept=%llu|indexed_rollback=%llu|native_install_commits=%llu|native_promotion_commits=%llu|extra_packet_identity_bits=0|directory_bound_wb_uid_bits=32|indexed_control_read_views=3|indexed_control_update_lanes=3|metadata_PPA=UNKNOWN|metadata_clock_closure=UNKNOWN\n",
248:       slice,m_tvd_lookup_queries,m_tvd_indexed_completions,m_tvd_indexed_accepts,
249:       m_tvd_indexed_rollbacks,m_tvd_native_installs,m_tvd_native_promotions);
250:   fprintf(fp, "EPL2TVDV2|SUMMARY|slice=%u|clean_installs=%llu|dirty_installs=%llu|"
251:       "read_responses=%llu|dirty_forward_responses=%llu|served_sectors=%llu|served_sector_bytes=%llu|"
252:       "promotions=%llu|live=%u|mandatory=%u|role_tvd=%u|retention_slot_cycles=%llu|"
253:       "clean_retention_slot_cycles=%llu|total_retention_slot_cycles=%llu|"
254:       "lookup_wait_cycles=%llu|wb_wait_cycles=%llu|bank_wait_cycles=%llu|icnt_wait_cycles=%llu|directory_queries=%llu\n", slice,
255:       (unsigned long long)s.clean_installs, (unsigned long long)s.dirty_installs,
256:       (unsigned long long)s.read_responses, (unsigned long long)s.dirty_forward_responses,
257:       (unsigned long long)s.served_sectors, (unsigned long long)s.served_sector_bytes,
258:       (unsigned long long)s.promotions, m_tvd->occupied(), m_tvd->mandatory(),
259:       m_ep_l2_payload.tvd_used(), (unsigned long long)s.tvd_extra_retention_slot_cycles,
260:       (unsigned long long)s.clean_retention_slot_cycles,
261:       (unsigned long long)(s.clean_retention_slot_cycles + s.tvd_extra_retention_slot_cycles),
262:       m_tvd_lookup_wait, m_tvd_wb_wait, m_tvd_bank_wait, m_tvd_resp_wait, m_tvd_lookup_queries);
263: }
